limits: Four dependent authored families and one question set do not establish broad accuracy, SOTA, professional safety or learner benefit.
Report values are expanded from selected evidence. The experiment measures identity, evidence selection, temporal scope, coverage and uncertainty, not unconstrained prose quality.
All 48 structural acceptances coexist with four semantic failures; structural validation does not prove that the intended question or flight was answered.
The versions run in fixed order, so timings are descriptive. Offline execution did not enforce client/driver deadlines, and engine stop reasons remain inferred.
The new worlds are evaluation fixtures, not Heathrow operational data or implemented application lessons. No images, selected-aircraft cue, graph, training or prompt promotion was added.
Original result files, frozen research, approved videos and the separate typed-review limitations remain unchanged. No whole-course or physical-phone completion claim is made.
